normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 visible row text after ANSI-control removal and outer-whitespace trimming. Every row also pins its raw pre-redaction and exact raw/rendered post-redaction SHA-256.
policy: Candidate-only reconciliation of independently confirmed terminal crosschecks. Supported actions are blank-columns and blank-text. Overlapping file:row proposals are deduplicated, compatible column ranges are merged, and conflicts, tracked-history collisions, source locks, stale hashes, unsupported glyph projections, or geometry drift fail closed.
